en: A skate that buries itself in the white sand of the Rim, its back the colour of the shallows. Only its eyes show, and only when it has already decided.
Tide crawlers bleached chalky by days of white water. Out here there is no wall for them to climb, so they come straight on.
Not this turn's voice: she holds another element now.
Three tall hooded figures carrying Lamplighters' hooks, the lamp cages empty. They stand on the Choir's dais as if they have always stood there. They fight in silence, and they never look up.
A cairn has fallen into the water.
It changes its element on a rhythm. The timeline shows the next one.
Kerrid holds the line. Keep him standing.
There's a new way to fill the Swell. Choose it under Swell in the field menu.
White salt scraped from the cairns on the Pale Rim, fine as flour. Used in Customize.
Arm wraps bleached white by days of wading. He keeps retying them.
